title: Studying Scripture
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Studying Scripture is the careful, prayerful, and disciplined pursuit of understanding God’s Word. Study helps believers know truth more deeply, resist error, grow in wisdom, and live faithfully before God.
summary: Studying Scripture is the careful, prayerful, and disciplined pursuit of understanding God’s Word. Study helps believers know truth more deeply, resist error, grow in wisdom, and live faithfully before God.
christFocus: Study of Scripture should lead believers to deeper knowledge of Christ, not mere information. The goal is to know, trust, worship, obey, and proclaim Jesus more faithfully through the Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God’s Word deserves careful attention. Studying Scripture goes beyond casual reading by seeking to understand meaning, context, doctrine, application, and how each passage fits within the whole counsel of God.

Ezra set his heart to study the law of the Lord, to do it, and to teach it. This pattern matters: study is not meant to produce pride or detached knowledge, but obedience and faithful instruction.

The Bereans examined the Scriptures to test what they heard. Their example shows that study is a noble and necessary practice. Believers are not called to blind acceptance, but to Scripture-shaped discernment.

Wisdom is found by seeking God’s truth like treasure. Scripture study requires effort, but the reward is deepened understanding, stronger faith, greater discernment, and a life more firmly anchored in God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A shallow grasp of Scripture leaves believers vulnerable. They may be easily confused by false teaching, discouraged by hard passages, or dependent on others for every answer. Study helps believers become rooted rather than tossed around.

This doctrine also protects teachers and leaders from careless handling of the Word. Those who teach must labor to understand Scripture faithfully so they do not mislead the people God has entrusted to them.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Study Scripture with humility and perseverance. Ask questions of the text, consider context, compare Scripture with Scripture, use faithful helps when needed, and seek to obey what you learn. Do not study to appear knowledgeable; study so you may know God, follow Christ, and serve others well.
